name: MartingailExpert
summary: This EA implements a classic Martingale strategy where it doubles the lot size after each losing trade, aiming to recover losses with a single winning trade. It enters positions based on a simple signal (typically a single indicator or price action condition) and relies on the Martingale progression rather than technical edge for profitability. The strategy is inherently risky as it assumes unlimited capital and no consecutive loss limits.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了经典的马丁格尔策略，每次亏损后将手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利来覆盖之前的所有亏损。它基于简单信号入场，依赖马丁格尔加仓而非技术优势来获利。该策略本质上风险极高，因为它假设资金无限且不存在连续亏损上限。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用马丁格尔策略核心概念，即在每次交易亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，期望一次盈利即可覆盖之前所有累计亏损。入场条件通常基于简单的技术指标信号或固定方向交替下单，没有复杂的过滤机制。出场条件依赖于整个马丁格尔序列的累计盈利目标，当总浮盈达到设定值时全部平仓。仓位管理是策略的核心——每轮首次交易使用初始手数，亏损后按倍数递增（如0.01→0.02→0.04→0.08），直到盈利重置回初始手数。资金管理方面，该策略没有设置最大连续亏损次数限制，也没有账户余额比例的动态调整机制，仅依赖翻倍逻辑。这种策略在理论上可以盈利，但在实际交易中面临爆仓的极端风险，因为连续亏损会导致手数呈指数级增长，很快超出账户承受能力。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements the core concept of the Martingale strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade in the expectation that a single win will recover all accumulated losses. Entry conditions are typically based on a simple technical indicator signal or alternating direction without sophisticated filtering mechanisms. Exit conditions depend on the cumulative profit target of the entire Martingale sequence, closing all positions when total floating profit reaches a preset threshold. Position sizing is the heart of the strategy — the first trade in each cycle uses an initial lot size, and after each loss the lot is multiplied (e.g., 0.01→0.02→0.04→0.08) until a win resets it back to the initial size. Money management lacks a maximum consecutive loss limit or dynamic account balance ratio adjustment, relying solely on the doubling logic. While theoretically profitable, this strategy faces extreme risk of account blowup in practice, as consecutive losses cause exponential lot growth that quickly exceeds account capacity.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 初始手数，马丁格尔序列的起始交易量
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, starting volume of martingale sequence

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: 亏损后手数乘数，经典马丁格尔为2倍
parameters.description_en: Lot multiplier after loss, classic martingale is 2x

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，单笔或序列的盈利目标
parameters.description_en: Group take profit target amount (in currency)

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: MaxOrders
parameters.description: 最大订单数限制，0表示无限制

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单

pros: 逻辑简单直观，代码易于理解和修改
在震荡行情中配合浮盈平仓可以实现稳定的小额盈利
初始手数可以设置得很小，短期回撤可控
参数灵活可调，乘数和初始手数均可根据账户大小调整
理论上在资金无限的前提下可以100%回收亏损
pros_en: Simple and intuitive logic, easy to understand and modify the code
Can achieve steady small profits in ranging markets when combined with floating profit closing
Initial lot size can be set very small, keeping short-term drawdown manageable
Flexible parameters — multiplier and initial lots are adjustable based on account size
Theoretically guarantees loss recovery assuming unlimited capital
cons: 手数呈指数增长，连续亏损后极易爆仓
没有最大连续亏损次数限制，风险无法控制
不设止损或止损过宽，单笔亏损可能极大
依赖账户资金而非策略优势盈利，本质是赌博而非交易
在趋势行情中逆势加仓会导致灾难性亏损
没有考虑点差和佣金成本对马丁格尔序列的累积影响
cons_en: Lot sizes grow exponentially, making account blowup highly likely after consecutive losses
No maximum consecutive loss limit, meaning risk is uncontrollable
No stop loss or overly wide stop loss, single trade loss can be enormous
Relies on account capital rather than strategy edge for profitability — essentially gambling not trading
Trading against the trend with increasing lots in trending markets leads to catastrophic losses
Does not account for cumulative impact of spreads and commissions on the Martingale sequence
improvements: 增加最大连续亏损次数限制，达到上限后强制平仓并重置序列
加入趋势过滤指标（如均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势加仓
引入账户余额比例的动态仓位管理，根据净值调整初始手数和乘数
设置整体止损线，当浮亏超过账户余额一定比例时全部平仓
加入点差过滤和交易时段过滤，减少不利条件下的开仓
improvements_en: Add a maximum consecutive loss limit that forces closure and sequence reset when reached
Incorporate trend filtering indicators (e.g., MA direction) to avoid counter-trend position scaling in strong trends
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance ratio, adjusting initial lots and multiplier based on equity
Set an overall stop-loss line that closes all positions when floating loss exceeds a certain percentage of account balance
Add spread filter and trading session filter to reduce entries under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 马丁格尔翻倍逻辑导致手数指数增长，连续亏损极易爆仓
没有止损保护，单笔亏损可能耗尽账户
没有最大订单数限制，允许无限加仓
逆势加仓在趋势行情中会产生灾难性浮亏
不考虑点差和佣金累积成本，实际回本概率低于理论值
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling logic causes exponential lot growth, making account blowup highly likely during losing streaks
No stop loss protection means a single trade loss can deplete the account
No maximum order limit allows unlimited position scaling
Counter-trend position scaling creates catastrophic floating losses in trending markets
Ignoring cumulative spread and commission costs means actual recovery probability is lower than theoretical value
